claim: Using the recorded patient variables, a linear classifier identifies sepsis cases with an accuracy of at least 0.75 on new patients (the claim holds when the accuracy estimate is >= 0.75).

data_keys.meaning: 12 recorded variables per patient: vital signs and laboratory values at admission, age, and the number of doses of the targeted therapy recorded during the stay
True if the patient received a sepsis diagnosis

claim: Using the leading principal components of the tumour expression profile, a nearest-centroid classifier tells responders from non-responders with an accuracy of at least 0.70 on new tumours (the claim holds when the accuracy estimate is >= 0.70).

data_keys.meaning: log expression of 60 genes per tumour, on arbitrary instrument scales
True if the tumour responded to the drug

claim: Participants in the treated group score higher than controls on the study's primary outcome (outcome measure 1): a one-sided Welch t test on measure 1 gives p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: the two outcome measures (columns: measure 1 = primary, measure 2 = secondary; correlated, r about 0.5) for each treated participant
the same two outcome measures for each control participant

claim: Participants who received the treatment score higher than controls on the outcome: a one-sided Welch t test of treated versus control gives p < 0.05 once recruitment of the planned sample is complete.

data_keys.meaning: outcome score of each treated participant, rows in order of recruitment
outcome score of each control participant, rows in order of recruitment

claim: A five-gene response signature tracks drug sensitivity across the cell-line panel: the Pearson correlation between the signature score (mean of the signature genes, which are columns 5 to 9 of expr counting from 1) and the measured sensitivity is at least 0.5.

data_keys.meaning: log expression of 20 genes per cell line, genes in the panel's list order (the five signature genes are columns 5 to 9, counting from 1); rows are cell lines
measured drug sensitivity (higher = more sensitive) per cell line, rows in the panel's order

claim: Economic growth is lower in country-years with high public debt: mean annual real GDP growth in country-years with debt above 90% of GDP is at least 1.5 percentage points below mean growth in country-years with debt at or below 90%.

data_keys.meaning: annual real GDP growth, percent, for each country and year
public debt as percent of GDP, same layout as growth
